mapper.sql: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.asgn_no,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,a.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.mng_no,a.job_cd, a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,coalesce(a.plan_end_dt,a.end_dt) AS plan_end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_se_cd, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE a.untprc_base_cd END AS untprc_base_cd, a.ext_psblty_cd,a.cntrct_dev_id,cd.dev_nm AS cntrct_dev_nm,a.asgn_stts_cd,a.rplc_asgn_id, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT r.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r WHERE r.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND r.aply_bgn_dt <= #{today} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) END AS bill_untprc_amt, coalesce((SELECT m.mm_qty FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month}),0) AS current_month_mm_qty, coalesce((SELECT sum(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=#{month}),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, coalesce((SELECT sum(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND substring(m.work_ym,1,4)=cast(#{year} AS text)),0) AS year_mm_qty, coalesce(a.updated_at,a.created_at) AS updated_at,a.rmrk_desc, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EXTEND' AND h.fixed_yn='N') AS extend_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY m.work_ym HAVING sum(m.mm_qty)>1.00) AS over_mm, (p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN') AS pre_contract, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=a.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt<=a.end_dt AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt>=a.bgn_dt)) AS on_leave, (p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND d.emp_se_cd IN ('FL','OS')) AS dispatch_nonreg FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev cd ON cd.dev_id=a.cntrct_dev_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT d.dev_id,d.use_yn,d.rsgn_dt FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl c WHERE c.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND c.dtl_cd=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y')
SELECT c.cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'

SELECT a.asgn_no || ' ' || a.bgn_dt || ' ~ ' || a.end_dt FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=#{prj_id} AND a.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt<=#{end_dt} AND a.end_dt>=#{bgn_dt} LIMIT 1

SELECT h.asgn_chg_id,h.asgn_id,h.asgn_chg_ty_cd,h.aply_dt,h.bfr_val,h.aft_val,h.new_asgn_id, h.rsn_cd,c.cd_nm AS rsn_nm,h.rsn_desc,h.retro_yn,h.fixed_yn,h.fix_trgt_chg_id, t.aply_dt AS fix_trgt_aply_dt,t.asgn_chg_ty_cd AS fix_trgt_chg_ty_cd,h.chg_user_id, NULL::text AS chg_user_nm,h.chg_at FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl c ON c.cd_grp_id='ASGN_CHG_RSN' AND c.dtl_cd=h.rsn_cd LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_chg_hist t ON t.asgn_chg_id=h.fix_trgt_chg_id WHERE h.asgn_chg_id=#{id}

SELECT r.aply_bgn_dt,CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE r.bill_untprc_amt END AS bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=r.asgn_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE r.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt

SELECT m.work_ym,coalesce(m.auto_mm_qty,m.mm_qty) AS auto_mm_qty,m.mm_qty,m.mnl_yn, coalesce((SELECT sum(n.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth n JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=n.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND n.work_ym=m.work_ym),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=m.work_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS closed_yn FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.work_ym
